question: What transformative power is attributed to merely hearing this knowledge?
premises: The means is this knowledge alone.
The knowledge is received by hearing.
The statement is addressed to the fair-faced one.
inference: Mere hearing of this knowledge is presented as having significant effect.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically incomplete and its main result is carried into the next verse.
plain_english: O fair-faced one, by this mere knowledge, heard and received...
